name: Business Central to Shopify - Inventory Update
description: Reads inventory changes from Business Central through the Fintegrator BC Connector extension, delta-filtered by the monotonic entry number kept in persisted state. Because inventorySetQuantities writes absolute values and fan-out children run concurrently, the batch is first collapsed to the newest movement per SKU + location, then fanned out one child per key: each child requires an exact SKU match, resolves the target location (shopifyLocationByBcLocation map, then shopifyLocationId, then the first active location) and sets the absolute available quantity with a deterministic idempotency key. Items without a matching variant, without inventory tracking or without a location are reported as skipped instead of failing.
